versions.changelog:
- Added "curl" and "jq" as required system binaries in the skill metadata.
- No other user-facing documentation or usage changes.

Initial release: search real-world places using natural language via Camino AI.

- Natural language queries return relevant places with coordinates, distance, and metadata.
- Supports flexible search options (by name, attributes, coordinates, or OSM IDs).
- Optional AI ranking of results and AI-generated summaries.
- Easy trial setup; supports up to 25 free calls without signup.
- Customizable parameters (radius, limit, mode, historical queries, etc.).
- Output includes structured data and optional human-readable answers.
